Beijing Imposes Total Ban on Drone Possession

Beijing has implemented a complete ban on the possession of drones within the city limits. This move follows earlier efforts by authorities to tighten regulations surrounding drone usage. The updated regulations were enacted after a deadly crash, though specific details of the crash were not provided in the coverage. The ban applies to all drone possession within the capital.
